response.contact_name: Nullable display name of the resolved contact or email recipient.
response.membership: Pending proposals in unexpired distilling post-call sessions for active board deals. Ordered by created_at, then id.
response.overflow: post_call_followups_limit_exceeded; no partial snapshot is returned.

home_slice: Home preserves assigned task controls and shows pending email subject, recipient reference and deal in Team view. Review draft opens the exact call session in local Call Mode; email approval and draft creation remain there.
resolution: Existing resolve-post-call-candidate records an assigned action or skips one proposal. It does not perform the described action. Email resolution confirms only metadata and a local body hash; it creates no email or Outlook draft.
